Container.Name: qm-socket-proxy
Container.Overview: Dedicated authenticated Docker API proxy required by Quartermaster Companion. It keeps the Docker socket out of the main application and does not publish a host port.
Container.Requires: Install before qm-companion. Keep the container name, do not publish port 2375 and use the same QM_PROXY_KEY in both templates.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Docker socket used by the restricted proxy. Keep this mount read only.

Config.Name: Proxy key
Config.Description: Shared key used to authenticate Companion. Generate it with openssl rand -hex 32 and enter the same value in qm-companion.

Config.Name: Docker writes
Config.Description: Keep 0 for read only. Set 1 only when qm-companion uses the manage or shell access level.

Config.Name: Container shell
Config.Description: Keep 0 unless qm-companion uses the shell access level.

Config.Name: Events API
Config.Description: Allows Companion to follow Docker events.

Config.Name: Host information API
Config.Description: Allows Companion to read Docker host information.

Config.Name: Disk usage API
Config.Description: Allows Companion to read Docker disk usage.

Config.Name: Ping API
Config.Description: Allows Companion to check the Docker connection.

Config.Name: Version API
Config.Description: Allows Companion to read the Docker API version.
